name: Starter Deck GX Koleksi TAG TEAM
englishName: GX Starter Deck: Tag Team Collection

description.text: GX Starter Deck: TAG TEAM Collection, released with the fifth Indonesian Sun & Moon expansion as TAG TEAM cards arrived: a random ready-to-play 60-card deck with one Pokémon-GX, damage counters, a GX marker and a rule book. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
